observations: Black vintage sewing machine with gold decorative decals mounted on a wooden table
Handwheel visible on the right side of the machine head
No readable brand name or model number visible on the machine in the photo
Watermark text "SUNDAY ADENIYI" across the center of the image
Machine appears used and dusty, consistent with age

claims.evidence: A still photo cannot show whether the machine runs or stitches
No demonstration of operation or stitching is provided

risks.risk: Machine may not run or stitch due to seized mechanism, broken belt, or missing internal parts
risks.proof: Video of the handwheel turning freely and the machine stitching on fabric

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as bobbin, needle, presser foot, or power cord
risks.proof: Close-up photo showing all included accessories and the machine base

risks.risk: Hidden damage to the wood table or machine body not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Additional photos of all sides of the table and underside of the machine head
risks.if_unproven: with visible wear only, no allowance for hidden damage

proof_requests: Video showing the handwheel turning and the machine stitching a piece of fabric
Close-up photos of any brand plate, model label, or serial number
Photos showing all accessories included with the machine
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a vintage sewing machine even without a readable brand, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working based on the photo alone.
